resources.string:
For seeing other tools' entries and variables as lines, bars, pies or calendars.
## What it does
- It keeps no data itself
- It reads its sources again at each display, over the period chosen
## Not made for
- Computing or keeping a total (a variable or a Goal)

## What it shows
- Period shown: the span of time shown, counted from the moment of display
- Views: one or several charts, each with its Title, and Views per row to lay them out
- Composition: a single view, or several, one under the other, side by side, in rows, one per category or one per column

## The layers
Each view stacks layers.
- Source: a tool's entries, or a grid that reads variables and values at each step
- Step: the grid's interval (a day, a week…)
- Columns read: each with a Name and what is Read
- Transforms: group or reshape the rows before drawing them
- Mark: line, point, bar, area, text, arc…

## The channels
The part each column plays in the drawing: position, colour, size, shape…
- Scale: Bounds, From zero, Reversed
- Axis and Legend: what shows around the chart

This is the richest part of the app. The AI knows how to fill it: describe the chart you want.

## The chart
The chart, with its legend under it.
Touch a point or a bar to see its value under the chart, with every column of its row. When a value is missing, the reason shows, with the entries to correct.
The chart updates as soon as an entry it reads changes.

A chart of other tools\' entries and of variables, drawn and never computed: a subset of Vega-Lite (layer, vconcat, hconcat, concat, facet, repeat; marks line, point, bar, area, text, arc, tick, rect; encoding channels) whose data come from a source per layer, never written in the config: a tool\'s entries, or a grid reading variables and field readings at each step of the displayed period. A total per day is a grid column, never an aggregate. Colors are palette names. Keeps no entries of its own.
